title: Knee push-up

steps.text: Kneel on a mat or soft floor. Put your palms flat on the floor, shoulder-width apart, fingers pointing forward.
Move your weight forward until your shoulders are over your hands and your body is one line from knees to head.
steps.cue: Shoulders over hands. One line from the knees.

steps.text: Firm your belly and bend your elbows to lower your chest slowly toward the floor. Go only as far as you can control.
steps.cue: Belly firm. Lower your chest slowly.

steps.text: Press through your hands until your arms are straight. Keep your head in line with your back.
steps.cue: Press up until your arms are straight.

mistakes: Letting the lower back sag or the hips lift.
Dropping the head toward the floor.
regression: Lower only part of the way, or go back to wall push-ups.
stopIf: Stop if you feel pain in your wrists, elbows, shoulders or lower back.

anatomy.why: The chest and the back of the arms push the floor away, while the belly keeps the body in one line.
